'''Jeade'en''' is the name of one of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s horses. His name means "True Finder" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==Appearance==
Jeade'en is a dappled stallion of the best of [[Tear|Tairen]] bloodstock.

==Activities==
After taking the [[Stone of Tear]], Rand chooses a sturdy horse from the stables and names him Jeade'en. Jeade'en carries Rand away from Tear on their way to the [[Portal Stone]] and into the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref/book|4|22}} Jeade'en is used by Rand as he makes his way across the Waste; journeying from [[Rhuidean]] to [[Cold Rocks Hold]],{{ref/book|4|36}}{{ref/book|4|48}} from Cold Rocks Hold to [[Alcair Dal]]{{ref/book|4|49}} and from Alcair Dal to the [[Jangai Pass]].{{ref/book|5|7}} As they enter [[Cairhien]], Jeade'en carries Rand from [[Taien]]{{ref/book|5|20}} to [[Selean]]{{ref/book|5|23}} to the city of [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]].{{ref/book|5|44}}{{ref/book|5|45}}{{ref/book|5|46}} Rand also rides Jeade'en while [[Traveling]] from the docks of Cairhien to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|6|10}} 

==Namesake==
Rand read that [[Jain Farstrider]] rode a horse named Jeade'en. He liked the name and used it for his horse.
